definition: Report the number of full-time equivalent (FTE) certified, noncertified, and contract teachers on lines 1-3, respectively. These amounts may include fractional FTE for part-time teachers. A teacher should be reported on only 1 line. If a teacher is both a certified and contract teacher, report only the applicable FTE on line 3. Do not include instructional aides or assistants.
reason: FY2025 does not resolve FY2023/24 teacher missingness. Charter snapshot/grade allocation is not a city-complete teacher denominator.
